cards.question: ア
cards.explanation: Vowel 'a' as in 'father'. Looks like an arrow pointing left.
cards.explanation_pt: Vogal 'a' como em 'pai'. Parece uma flecha apontando para a esquerda.

cards.question: イ
cards.explanation: Vowel 'i' as in 'see'. Looks like an eagle's beak.
cards.explanation_pt: Vogal 'i' como em 'vi'. Parece o bico de uma águia.

cards.question: ウ
cards.explanation: Vowel 'u' as in 'flute'. Looks like a u-shaped bowl.
cards.explanation_pt: Vogal 'u' como em 'uva'. Parece uma tigela em forma de u.

cards.question: エ
cards.explanation: Vowel 'e' as in 'pet'. Looks like an elevator - horizontal lines.
cards.explanation_pt: Vogal 'e' como em 'pé'. Parece um elevador - linhas horizontais.

cards.question: オ
cards.explanation: Vowel 'o' as in 'boat'. Looks like an opera singer.
cards.explanation_pt: Vogal 'o' como em 'ovo'. Parece um cantor de ópera.

cards.question: カ
cards.explanation: K-row. Looks like a katana sword blade.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha K. Parece a lâmina de uma espada katana.

cards.question: キ
cards.explanation: K-row. Looks like a key with teeth.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha K. Parece uma chave com dentes.

cards.question: ク
cards.explanation: K-row. Looks like a cook's knife blade.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha K. Parece a lâmina de uma faca de cozinheiro.

cards.question: ケ
cards.explanation: K-row. Looks like a crooked K.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha K. Parece um K torto.

cards.question: コ
cards.explanation: K-row. Looks like a corner - two lines at right angle.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha K. Parece um canto (corner) - duas linhas em ângulo reto.

cards.question: サ
cards.explanation: S-row. Looks like a 'sa'murai sword crossed.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha S. Parece uma espada samurai cruzada.

cards.question: シ
cards.explanation: S-row. Looks like a smiling face (͡° ͜ʖ ͡°) - 'shi'ny smile!
cards.explanation_pt: Linha S. Parece um rosto sorridente (͡° ͜ʖ ͡°).

cards.question: ス
cards.explanation: S-row. Looks like a ski slope swoosh.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha S. Parece o movimento de uma pista de esqui.

cards.question: セ
cards.explanation: S-row. Looks like a person 'se'tting something down.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha S. Parece uma pessoa colocando algo no chão.

cards.question: ソ
cards.explanation: S-row. Two strokes going same direction (vs シ opposite).
cards.explanation_pt: Linha S. Dois traços indo na mesma direção.

cards.question: タ
cards.explanation: T-row. Looks like a letter 'ta'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha T. Parece a sílaba 'ta'.

cards.question: チ
cards.explanation: T-row. Looks like a cheerleader's pom-pom on a stick.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha T. Parece o pom-pom de uma líder de torcida.

cards.question: ツ
cards.explanation: T-row. Three dots like water droplets - tsunami!
cards.explanation_pt: Linha T. Três pontos como gotas de água - tsunami!

cards.question: テ
cards.explanation: T-row. Looks like a telephone pole with wire.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha T. Parece um poste de telefone com fio.

cards.question: ト
cards.explanation: T-row. Looks like a totem pole - simple vertical + horizontal.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha T. Parece um totem - simples vertical e horizontal.

cards.question: ナ
cards.explanation: N-row. Looks like a knife crossing.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha N. Parece uma faca cruzando.

cards.question: ニ
cards.explanation: N-row. Two horizontal lines - like 'ni' (two) in Japanese!
cards.explanation_pt: Linha N. Duas linhas horizontais - como 'ni' (dois) em japonês!

cards.question: ヌ
cards.explanation: N-row. Looks like noodles being twirled.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha N. Parece macarrão sendo enrolado.

cards.question: ネ
cards.explanation: N-row. Looks like a fishing net.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha N. Parece uma rede de pesca.

cards.question: ノ
cards.explanation: N-row. Single diagonal stroke - like saying 'no'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha N. Traço diagonal único - como dizer 'não'.

cards.question: ハ
cards.explanation: H-row. Looks like 'ha ha' - two diagonal laughing lines.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha H. Parece 'ha ha' - dois traços diagonais de riso.

cards.question: ヒ
cards.explanation: H-row. Looks like a smiling face on its side - 'hee hee'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha H. Parece um rosto sorridente de lado - 'hee hee'.

cards.question: フ
cards.explanation: H-row. Looks like Mt. Fuji's peak. Between 'fu' and 'hu'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha H. Parece o cume do Monte Fuji. Entre 'fu' e 'hu'.

cards.question: ヘ
cards.explanation: H-row. Identical to hiragana へ - a simple peak.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha H. Idêntico ao hiragana へ - um cume simples.

cards.question: ホ
cards.explanation: H-row. Looks like a holy cross with extra strokes.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha H. Parece uma cruz sagrada com traços extras.

cards.question: マ
cards.explanation: M-row. Looks like a mother's arms cradling.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha M. Parece os braços de uma mãe embalando.

cards.question: ミ
cards.explanation: M-row. Three horizontal lines - like the number 3.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha M. Três linhas horizontais - como o número 3.

cards.question: ム
cards.explanation: M-row. Looks like a cow's head - 'moo'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha M. Parece a cabeça de uma vaca - 'muuu'.

cards.question: メ
cards.explanation: M-row. Looks like an X - 'me'aning crossed out.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha M. Parece um X - riscado.

cards.question: モ
cards.explanation: M-row. Looks like the letter E - think 'more E'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha M. Parece a letra E.

cards.question: ヤ
cards.explanation: Y-row. Looks like a yak's horns.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha Y. Parece os chifres de um iaque.

cards.question: ユ
cards.explanation: Y-row. Looks like a U - 'you'.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha Y. Parece a letra U.

cards.question: ヨ
cards.explanation: Y-row. Looks like the letter E rotated - think 'yo!'
cards.explanation_pt: Linha Y. Parece a letra E rotacionada.

cards.question: ラ
cards.explanation: R-row. Looks like a rabbit ear. R sounds like L in Japanese.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha R. Parece a orelha de um coelho. R soa como L em japonês.

cards.question: リ
cards.explanation: R-row. Looks like the letter 'ri' - two vertical strokes.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha R. Dois traços verticais.

cards.question: ル

cards.explanation_pt: Linha R. Parece o calcanhar de um sapato.

cards.question: レ
cards.explanation: R-row. Looks like a razor blade - single curved stroke.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha R. Parece uma lâmina de barbear.

cards.question: ロ
cards.explanation: R-row. Looks like a square mouth - 'ro'bot.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha R. Parece uma boca quadrada - robô.

cards.question: ワ
cards.explanation: W-row. Looks like a wine glass - 'wa'ine.
cards.explanation_pt: Linha W. Parece uma taça de vinho.

cards.question: ヲ
cards.explanation: Rare particle. Looks like フ + horizontal stroke.
cards.explanation_pt: Partícula rara. Parece フ + um traço horizontal.

cards.question: ン
cards.explanation: Standalone consonant. Like a stylized 'n' or wave.
